name: schema-change-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating proposed schema changes and their cross-service efficiency impact

options.description: Approve: low-risk change with clear efficiency benefit (e.g., adding index, nullable column)
Approve: moderate-risk change requiring coordinated migration across services
Reject: high-risk change with potential for significant compatibility breakage or performance regression
Defer: insufficient data to predict impact; recommend A/B testing or gradual rollout

evaluation_factors: Historical schema change outcomes for similar patterns
